title: An OAuth app
description: An OAuth app people sign in with: who holds it, where it came from, and the service's app. Never its client secret.

issuer.description: The authorization server's issuer URL. Its metadata provides the endpoints.

resource.description: The API or MCP server that the tokens are for. If you don't set issuer, Wardrik finds it from this URL.

authorization_endpoint.description: The URL where people sign in, for a service that doesn't publish metadata. Set together with token_endpoint.

token_endpoint.description: The token endpoint. Set together with authorization_endpoint.

client_id.description: The OAuth app's client ID. If you leave it empty, Wardrik registers itself as a client, if the service allows it.

client_secret.description: The vault secret holding the app's client secret. Omitted for an app without one, and for one in config.yaml.

name.description: The name of the secret in the owner's vault.

client_auth.description: How the client secret is sent: in the form, or as HTTP Basic.

flow.description: How a person signs in: in a browser, or with a code on another device.

authorization_params.description: Extra parameters for the browser sign-in, for example access_type: offline. You can't override the parameters Wardrik sets.
